That's exactly the behavior I wanted. When I pasted the roast-potato address I'd already saved and hit Save, it didn't make a second copy — the collection stayed at eight, it jumped me down to the existing roast-potato item, highlighted it, and told me "Already saved — here it is in your collection." So instead of quietly piling up duplicates, it points me at the one I already have. That's the little thing that drives me nuts today, and this handles it just right.

And I like that it catches the duplicate straight from the address before bothering to fetch details or open a review — no wasted step.

I'm happy with duplicate handling. That covers everything I raised back at the start — saving, readable details, opening the real page, editing, labels, search, read-later, archiving, delete, and no duplicates. What's next?
